status: Corrected single USD14 attempt; full source-bound proof required.

configuration.initial_condition: Original analytic legacy tubes: gamma=5, a=.25, sep=.6, pert=.35; same audited projection, no N512 restart
configuration.target_t_interpretation: Required common interval only; no later-time exploration or turnover claim.

spatial_acceptance.actual_end: minimum of both last accepted diagnostic times
primary_curve_metrics: max matched net-production difference scaled by production-plus-loss
spatial_acceptance.net_curve_difference: absolute difference divided by maximum of both production-plus-viscous-loss magnitudes and 1e-14
secondary_metrics: grid wmax and grid-based BKM, both sampling-sensitive
spatial_acceptance.intermediate_band: greater than 0.001 and less than 0.01: inconclusive sensitivity
spatial_acceptance.interpretation: Consistency of sampled observables on two discretizations, not proof of resolution or convergence order.
spatial_acceptance.beyond_common_window: single-grid exploratory observations only; no N512/N640 convergence claim

grid_sampled_wmax.role: secondary sensitivity screen, not primary acceptance
measures: sampled time reported without a timing gate
grid_sampled_wmax.explanation: Different grids sample different positions. No retrospective spectral interpolation of the N512 t=0.89 maximum is possible from the retained endpoint fields.
grid_sampled_wmax.borderline_interpretation: Sampling-inconclusive secondary screen; neither crossing 1% nor the retained N512 endpoint biases alone establishes discretization sensitivity. Integral curves and stable matched Fourier peak estimates determine their separately recorded primary classifications.

fitted_net_peak.role: supplementary only, never a protected-validation gate
fitted_net_peak.search_domain: each grid own accepted observed interval, separately labelled; no failing samples
fitted_net_peak.required_bracket: five uniform events centered on sampled maximum, with both sides accepted; also fit central three
fitted_net_peak.fitted_quantity: local quadratic vertex time and value
fitted_net_peak.uncertainty: Report 3/5-point fit sensitivity, half-event spacing, residual/curvature scale; not a statistical confidence interval or rigorous bound.
fitted_net_peak.classification: within declared tolerances, separated estimates, or inconclusive after sensitivity envelopes
fitted_net_peak.outside_common_interval: Supplementary comparison of separately observed local peaks only. Does not extend N512 validated trajectory, establish a global maximum, or certify later N640 temporal error.
fitted_net_peak.if_unbracketed: inconclusive, not failure of protected curve result

spatial_acceptance.primary_interpretation: 0.1% agreement of integral Z and scaled net-production curves on the common accepted interval. Percent-level discrepancy indicates discretization sensitivity; grid-maximum sampling does not control this label.

matched_fourier_wmax.role: primary matched local-peak observable, conditional on estimator stability on both grids

method.name: separable Fourier local search
method.scope: local peak estimate; seed and search sensitivity are not rigorous error bounds

matched_fourier_wmax.qualification: Fourier local peak estimate, not certified global supremum. Unstable estimates are explicitly inconclusive.
matched_fourier_wmax.historical_t0p89: No full N512 field; sampled maximum remains secondary.

notes: Finite diagnostics and exact matched output times are mandatory.
Tail cutoff is a heuristic; passing smoke does not establish high-Re grid convergence.
N32 reference is backend equivalence only; do not use its tail to certify spatial resolution.
Energy FD residual is interval-quadrature consistency, separate from instantaneous RHS identity.
Float64 smoke state is required: local float32 SSPRK3 TGV failed the 1% interval dissipation gate; the gate was retained.
Thresholds are fixed before H100 data; changes require a new recorded plan and review.

spectral_diagnostics.note: Preserve fixed k>=128 and N768-quarter k>=192 rounded-shell loss fractions/bounds at every event. Fractions are diagnostic, not a post-hoc gate.

temporal_validation.anchor: fixed N768 coarse checkpoint at t=1.00
temporal_validation.scope: Local continuation from the same N768 checkpoint; inherited time error is common. This does not certify accumulated N768 error at earlier peaks.
temporal_validation.if_unavailable: planned protected validation incomplete; preserve evidence and do not explore
temporal_validation.execution_phase: Immediately after accepted coarse prefix reaches1.10.
temporal_validation.beyond_1p1: Not part of this authorized experiment.

checkpoint_collection.arrays_to_collect: none by default; preserve all checkpoint metadata/component hashes and small evidence
checkpoint_collection.final_metadata_rule: archive exact checkpoint.json for every checkpoint before deleting any arrays; retain all per-component SHA256 values
checkpoint_collection.failing_terminal: diagnostics, spectra and exact metadata/hashes retained; arrays excluded from collection
checkpoint_collection.prune_rule: only new campaign fields; after successful fine-window validation and metadata archive; preserve prior campaign arrays
checkpoint_collection.collection: lossless gzip level 1, verified SHA256 of decompressed files, all diagnostic/config/timing files first
checkpoint_collection.checkpoint_time_note: The protected checkpoint is exactly t=1.10; exploratory fields have separate metadata/hash records.
checkpoint_collection.protected_small_artifacts: all prefix/fine diagnostics, full spectra, configs, source/runtime/timing/GPU records, checkpoint metadata/hash history, assessment; verified in WSL before exploration
checkpoint_collection.optional_checkpoint_priority: Production full-field archive/download disabled; local rehearsals cover optional transfer failures.
checkpoint_collection.memory_rule: Separate coarse/fine/exploration processes. Wait for process exit before the next load; do not retain two full trajectories on GPU.

overlap.transfer_allowance: 1.5*(actual compressed bytes/slowest probe + compression time + max(60s,2*remote verification time))
overlap.fallback: sequential collection and shortened/skipped exploration; protected snapshot stays immutable
overlap.pin: fixed coarse t=1.10 gzip archive; exploration writes a separate directory

checkpoint_collection.preflight_anchor_disk_note: Anchor plus up to three coarse states coexist; anchor released before fine/exploration. Existing six-state disk bound stays conservative; free-space gate after retention.
checkpoint_collection.scope: Metadata and component hashes mandatory; no full N768 fields downloaded.

budget.provider_guard_deadline: 60s before 10800s lifetime; measured phase includes cleanup/collection reserves.
budget.transfer_quote_rule: 14GB ingress and8.25GB conservative egress must fitUSD0.50 reserve; no raw-field download.

preflight.runtime_gate: Ordinary measured dt planning floor0.9*minimum excluding event-limited remainders; ceil(remaining time/floor)+one extra alignment step/event;400fine steps,117diagnostic events,31refined calls,12checkpoints;1.25compute margin+180s collection. Per-event remaining-phase guard unchanged.
preflight.CFL_rule: Preserve CFL0.2 and actual recorded limits; legitimate clipping increases projected step count. Tiny/nonfinite/invalid steps fail closed. This is an operational forecast correction, not a numerical-gate relaxation.
preflight.memory_between_phases: Sequential solver processes; driver and allocator fractions each<0.8.

execution_note: Only scripts/run_vast_third_grid.py --execute with complete exact proof/bootstrap/reference/payload/live offer/funding bindings.
scientific_goal: Original-IC N768 accepted0–1.10 plus same-grid fine1.00–1.10 and separately classified N512/N768, N640/N768 and signed three-grid trends.
higher_grid_scope: Only N768; no N1024. Old N640/H100 launchers and audited solver remain unchanged.
revision: CFL-aware count forecast; initial cap-only attempt preserved in published evidence.
